public_metadata.label: Mehdi demo with user-specified DE/rwalk mixture
public_metadata.description: User-specified rerun: 100,000 cached Morph proposals, 100 NIS live points, adaptive DE, DE/rwalk weights 80/20 with no stretch. No bandwidth flag; demo default scale 2. Existing cheap posterior training only. Upstream default of three recovery retries is explicitly recorded as heuristic. Smoke events 47 and 23 run first; original campaign retained separately.
public_metadata.training: Existing cheap nlive=100 posteriors, all saved rows; reference excluded from training/tuning
public_metadata.limitations: Stopping thresholds and Kish ESS do not certify mixing or unbiasedness; bounded recovery is heuristic.

test_note: Tests cover source/configuration, proposal density, moves, independent pool, sequencing/locking/restart, and estimator arithmetic. They do not certify unbiasedness.
